D.t: Tim Kennedy leads by 33.9 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 90,410 votes; a one point swing is about 1,334 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +26.7 and D +41.2. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
